section.title: The destinations our customers explore by car.
section.kicker: Routes, landscapes, and recommendations to truly enjoy Mendoza, with unlimited mileage in your rental car.

whatsappTemplate: Hi, I'd like to know more about {{name}} and the vehicles available to get there.

valle-de-uco.name: Uco Valley
valle-de-uco.description: One of the country's most prestigious wine regions, with striking architectural wineries, vineyards at the foot of the Andes, and exceptional cuisine. A perfect day trip from Mendoza city. It's just 1 hour from Mendoza City — perfect for going there and back in a day with your rental car.

san-rafael.name: San Rafael
san-rafael.description: Atuel Canyon, reservoirs, historic wineries, and a quiet town to use as a base. Ideal for long-weekend getaways or multi-day trips. It's about a 3-hour drive from Mendoza City, with unlimited mileage within the province.

malargue.name: Malargüe
malargue.description: The province's deep south: Las Leñas for winter skiing, Payunia and Caverna de las Brujas the rest of the year. Striking nature and scenic routes all the way in. It's about a 4-hour trip from Mendoza — with unlimited mileage within the province, pick an SUV and take your time.

gran-mendoza.name: Greater Mendoza
gran-mendoza.description: The capital and its surroundings: Maipú, Luján de Cuyo, Chacras de Coria. Top-tier wineries, boutique hotels, and the province's best restaurants, all minutes from downtown.

potrerillos.name: Potrerillos
potrerillos.description: A turquoise reservoir surrounded by mountains, with water sports, horseback rides, and excellent dining options. A half-day escape on the way to the high Andes. It's 1 hour from Mendoza City and easy to reach by car.

canon-del-atuel.name: Atuel Canyon
canon-del-atuel.description: Rock formations sculpted by the Atuel river over millions of years. Rafting, kayaking, and hiking through one of southern Mendoza's most photogenic landscapes. It's about 3.5 hours from Mendoza — with your rental car, you set the pace.
